notes: Server-authoritative casino. Every casino game now stakes bets and settles payouts on the server instead of trusting a client-reported balance. Closes the cash-sync exploit where a crafted WebSocket frame could set any balance. Payouts are capped per game, rounds that resolve implausibly fast are voided, and abandoned rounds forfeit their stake. Plinko removed (was dead code). New God Panel player-activity view lists a player's casino round history. Mining cash moved to its own channel. Hard-refresh after deploy. Carries 1.1.9.0 and earlier.
